newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM seen topping EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM seen topping EPS view.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst John Jones said he expected International Business Machines Corp to top the Wall Street consensus estimate of $2.28 per share for the first quarter.
-- "They're going to beat the consensus," Jones said. "Everybody has been concerned about their mainframe business, and that the numbers are going to be much worse than expected."
-- Jones said he "basically has taken a contrarian position. The data I get says the mainframe business is real weak, but it's only five to six percent of total revenues these days."
-- Jones said the computer giant is "having a very good quarter" in its UNIX product and storage businesses.
-- expects IBM to come close to earning $2.35 per share, Jones's estimate for the quarter.

-- said original equipment manufacturing and disk drives sales are "extremely strong" and said high-end storage disk sales "for the first time in four years are coming in close to the company's expectations, primarily because the relationship with Storage Technology Corp is finally starting to pay off."
-- reiterated a rating of strong buy.
